observation: Fresh main already made mission eventObject() authoritative over contiguous seq, timestamp, type, and data fields, but durable mission reads accepted any events array. A persisted mission could therefore rewrite or drop audit-event identity metadata and still be treated as valid.
changes: Validate durable mission event entries against the identity envelope already emitted by eventObject().
Require contiguous sequence numbers matching durable array order, non-empty timestamp and type, and presence of the data field while leaving event payload semantics open.
Publish the same minimal event envelope in Autonomous Mission v0.1 and add a focused tamper regression.

verification.pre_fix_source_contract_replay: EXPECTED FAIL: validMissionShape only checked that mission.events was an array, so forged sequence numbers and missing event envelope fields were readable.
verification.post_fix_bounded_reality_replay: PASS: the proposed predicate accepts a normal seq=1 event and rejects forged seq, blank timestamp/type, missing data, and null entries.
verification.syntax_check: PASS for the bounded Node replay of the event-envelope predicate.
verification.focused_regression_contract: tests/autonomous-mission-event-identity-integrity.test.mjs exercises generated contiguous events and durable tamper rejection against AutonomousMissionStore.

truth_boundary: This cycle does not make the event ledger cryptographically append-only and does not authenticate a consistently rewritten mission document. It only makes durable reads preserve the event identity/order envelope already generated by the existing writer.
